ios.desc:
The Official DestinFM Radio App — Your Soundtrack to Destin!

Experience Destin, Florida like a local with DestinFM — the local radio app built for the World’s Luckiest Fishing Village!

Listen to live local radio 24/7 featuring family-friendly music, local personalities, Destin news, entertainment, events, and Destin’s ONLY local weather forecast. Whether you're visiting the Emerald Coast, heading to the beach, cruising Crab Island, or living here year-round, DestinFM keeps you connected to everything happening in Destin.

Discover Destin
Find the best things to do, places to eat, beaches to visit, events to check out, and local attractions throughout Destin and the Emerald Coast.

Local Destin Weather
Get Destin-focused weather information to help you plan your beach days, boating adventures, fishing trips, and vacation.

Listen Live 24/7
Enjoy a family-friendly mix of music that captures the energy, sunshine, and laid-back spirit of Destin.

Make a Song Request
Want to hear your favorite song? Request it right from the app!

Destin Trivia
Test your knowledge of Destin, Florida and see how well you know the place we call home.

What's Happening in Destin
Stay up to date with local events, entertainment, restaurants, attractions, and things happening around town.

Whether you're planning a Destin vacation, spending the day on the beach, visiting Crab Island, exploring the Emerald Coast, or missing Destin from back home, the DestinFM app brings a little piece of the Emerald Coast with you wherever you go.

Don't do Destin without it! Download DestinFM and take the soundtrack of Destin with you.
